## label
Parasite as a host-associated harmful organism

## canonical_key
parasitology.foundations.parasite-definition

## aliases
Parasite definition
Parasitic organism

## arabic_label


## arabic_aliases
[clear]

## definition
A parasite is a living organism that lives in or on another organism and harms it.

## explicit_objective
Recognise the host-associated and harmful relationship that defines a parasite.

## pitfalls
A parasite does not benefit its host, and parasitism does not imply that the organism can live only outside a host.

## aliases
Facultative parasitism

## arabic_label


## arabic_aliases

## definition
A facultative parasite can alternate between free-living and parasitic modes of life.

## explicit_objective
Identify the ability to live either freely or parasitically as the defining feature of a facultative parasite.

## pitfalls
Facultative does not mean obligately host-dependent, necessarily endoparasitic, or dependent on multiple hosts.
